title: When to Ask for an App Store Review
hints: Track success count, last crash day and previous prompt days.
All four conditions must hold on a `success` event.
Count prompts within the last 365 days with `count(where:)`.
jsBridge: Deciding *when* to call `requestReview()` is product logic: after successes, not after crashes, and rate-limited. It's like gating an NPS survey in a web app, except Apple also enforces 3 prompts per year.

compass.q: An NPS survey gate in a web app vs `requestReview()`: what does Apple control that you don't (whether it shows at all)?
Why must the logic handle "prompt requested but system didn't show it"? Can you even tell?
In-app review prompt vs a link to the App Store review page: when is each appropriate?
Which user moments count as "success" in your app?
